headline: Route Mobile submits depository compliance certificate
hook: Routine compliance filing from Route Mobile
summary: Route Mobile Limited has submitted its compliance certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 to the stock exchange. This is a routine regulatory filing confirming dematerialisation and rematerialisation activities for the quarter. Such filings are mandatory for all listed companies to ensure compliance with depository participant rules. Indian retail investors are unaffected as this carries no financial or operational impact.
